summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Companhia Paranaense de Energia (COPEL), a Brazilian electric services company, for the month of May 2026. The filing contains no specific event or transaction; it includes only a signature by the CEO and standard forward-looking statement disclaimers. It serves as a periodic report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16, not tied to any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. No deal terms exist.
